comment: The trademark check (ROADMAP 9.8; docs/spec/trademarks.md). Avid's marks that may not name our menus, commands, windows, settings or effects: the names the guides mark with a trademark or registered sign ("source"), those the guides' trademark notice lists (Editing Guide p.2, FX Guide p.2-3: "and all related product names and logos"), and Avid's feature brand names. "status": renamed (ctest trademark_names fails when the name is in a user-visible string), planned (renamed in the step given; reported, not failed), absent (not in our UI; fails if it appears), nominative (kept: it names Avid's own product or format we interoperate with, and "reason" says where). "ours": our generic name. Other companies' marks (9.8d) carry an "owner"; their sources are the companies' published lists and the USPTO register (live marks in classes 9 and 42, read 2026-11-12; serial numbers given). "descriptive": a word the register or a list holds as a mark that we use only in its ordinary sense ("reason" says where); allowed.
